data.title: 伽玛 · 王都车站的迎接
data.description: 王都魔导列车站台上，伽玛抱着行程册等候。列车进站的蒸汽里，她踮脚张望——今天，暗影大人要来视察商会。
data.location: royal capital magic train station platform with steam and arriving carriages
data.action: standing on the platform holding an itinerary booklet, tiptoeing to look for someone in the steam, expectant smile
data.lighting: 清晨站台的薄雾与蒸汽中的柔光
data.promptProse: At the capital station, Gamma clutches the itinerary and rises on tiptoe through the steam — Shadow is visiting the company today.
data.animaCaption: Steam, schedules, and a president on tiptoe — some inspections matter more than business.
